name: job-hunter
description: Job Hunter: A comprehensive MERN stack job search portal with AI capabilities. It centralizes tech job opportunities, streamlines search with advanced filters, and offers AI-optimized job descriptions. Your one-stop solution for tech job hunting.

paragraphs: Welcome to Jobhunter, a full-stack MERN job portal project that connects job seekers and employers through an intelligent, AI-enhanced recruitment experience.

Whether you’re a developer looking for a GitHub project with AI integration, or an organization exploring how AI can enhance hiring workflows, Jobhunter is a modern example of integrating AI + MERN stack effectively.

Jobhunter isn’t just another job portal — it’s a smart recruitment ecosystem that leverages OpenAI’s API to automatically generate personalized job descriptions, helping companies attract better candidates faster.
features: ✅ User Authentication — Secure signup & login using JWT. ✅ AI Job Description Generator — Auto-generate optimized job posts using OpenAI. ✅ Job Search & Filtering — Advanced filters for job type, category, and location.…
